pixel_evaluation: native_original_image_and_mask (maps regenerated in memory from saved grids)

run_config.preprocess: agnostic: query PCA mask (upstream, threshold 10) computed at 448; references unmasked; 8 rotations
run_config.mask_672: 448 query mask projected to the 672 patch grid with cv2 INTER_NEAREST
run_config.fusion: 448 distance grid resampled to the 672 grid with cv2 INTER_LINEAR, weighted mean with the 672 grid
run_config.map: upstream dists2map(grid, native shape): INTER_LINEAR to native size + gaussian sigma 4; float32
run_config.image_score: upstream mean_top1p over the configuration grid (zeros on masked background included, as upstream)
run_config.threshold: shared normal_threshold: linear 95th percentile of the 20 calibration scores, per configuration
run_config.test_labels: used only by evaluation and post-hoc analysis

resources.peak_scope: calibration + test grid computation, both banks resident
resources.timing_note: grid pass only (read, 448 and 672 forward, PCA mask, 1-NN at both scales); maps, scores and fusion are excluded here. Comparable per-configuration end-to-end timing comes from --mode timing.

calibration_usage: 20 normal images for threshold only; no training or reference bank
